## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Sep 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            2. _kllre2847_, Sep 13, 2026, 4/5: "I really love this app. I feel there is enough variety and challenge that I don’t get bored and I love that it is very customizable and geared toward my personal goals. When I first started using it there were some glitches with the number of reps or with equipment but I don’t see that as much any more so it has either learned me or has been fixed. My only complaint is that I wish there was a dedicated core workout or that core was more of a focus for the workouts. Pretty much all I get are deadbugs and planks but I don’t always want to go searching to add other exercises, so typically I turn to YouTube to do an actual guided core workout after my Fitbod workout. Adding more core-focused sets would make this app pretty much perfect!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
